text: 12 May 2025, station S1. Oak litter, Berlese sample ran 48 h. Sorted 14 Isotoma viridis, all adults.
S3, 2025-05-13. Pine needles over thin soil. Folsomia candida, 6 individuals, two juveniles among them.
Station S2 on 14 May 2025. The funnel flooded overnight and the sample was lost; nothing sorted.
15 May 2025, S4. Moss cushion on a north-facing rock. Roughly a dozen Entomobrya nivalis; did not count exactly.
S5, 16/05/2025. Compost heap behind the field station: Ceratophysella denticulata swarming, 40 counted in the first tray.
17 May 2025 at S1. Searched the bark of three oaks for Entomobrya; none found. Two Orchesella cincta under loose bark instead.
18 May 2025. Cave entrance at S5. One Heteromurus nitidis, damaged, identification tentative.
19 May 2025, S2. Deep soil core, 10 to 20 cm. Pseudosinella alba x3.
20 May 2025. Olive grove near the village, no station number assigned yet. Grass litter, 5 Sminthurinus aureus.
21 May 2025, S3. Too dry to sample; will return after rain.
